'''Clear mushroom soup''' is a [[food]] in the 26.3 port of Matcha Flavoured (the 1.12.3 alpha for ''Minecraft'' 26.3 and the repository's 26.3 branch); it is not in [[Matcha Flavoured 1.12.4|1.12.4]], where a mooshroom milked with a bowl gives [[chocolate]]. It heals {{Hp|10}} and is eaten in 1.6 seconds. It is crafted from a [[Braised Mushroom|braised mushroom]], and it is also what a mooshroom gives when milked with a bowl, in place of the [[chocolate]] that the renamed mushroom stew would be.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/mushroom_soup.json|at=c8c13d7c0f57052846353ba8b0986896e9c95c4c}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==
=== Crafting ===
Dried kelp, a carrot, a [[Braised Mushroom|braised mushroom]] and a bowl, in any arrangement. Obtaining a braised mushroom unlocks the recipe.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/recipe_unlocks/braised_brown_mushroom.json|at=c8c13d7c0f57052846353ba8b0986896e9c95c4c}}</ref>

=== Milking a mooshroom ===
Using a bowl on a mooshroom runs an advancement that gives the player a clear mushroom soup and then clears the plain mushroom stew the bowl produced.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/mechanics/milked_mooshroom.json|at=c8c13d7c0f57052846353ba8b0986896e9c95c4c}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/mooshroom_milking/replace_chocolate_with_soup.mcfunction|at=c8c13d7c0f57052846353ba8b0986896e9c95c4c}}</ref> The pack turns the vanilla mushroom stew into chocolate, so without this step a mooshroom would be a source of chocolate.

== Usage ==
=== Food ===
Eating it takes 1.6 seconds and heals {{Hp|10}} (a hidden Regeneration III for 6 seconds). It has no other effect, and the bowl is returned.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/loot_table/food/matcha/mushroom_soup.json|at=c8c13d7c0f57052846353ba8b0986896e9c95c4c}}</ref>
